class: Any handling of broker/execution results that decides the outcome from the latest message (its status word, or the last reported position) instead of an invariant over the whole sequence can hide or clear a position mismatch, letting a new edit or execution start on an unreconciled position.
mechanism: The classifier returned PARTIAL for every PARTIAL status without checking the positions, so an extra futures line or a leg filled at 300 against 150 intended was recorded as an ordinary partial fill.

first_seen.evidence: Independent verifier probe: PARTIAL + unasked 75-unit FUT -> OutcomeKind.PARTIAL; PARTIAL overfill 300 vs 150 -> OutcomeKind.PARTIAL; tests green (19 passed).

fix: Position check first for every status: each contract's actual quantity must lie between the previous and the intended quantity (same side); any unasked contract, side flip or overfill is MISMATCH whatever the status word (W-012 fix round, f6c398d).

detection.note: Second occurrence triggered an independent review (learning rule R1). Guarded only when a property test over random result sequences asserts after every step: edits/confirmations/executions are allowed only while the last known broker position equals the active version's intended position; a mismatch stays until an explicit reconcile.

occurrences.evidence: PARTIAL status trusted: unasked FUT and 300-vs-150 overfill labelled PARTIAL

sequence of results: overfill MISMATCH then FAILED (nothing moved) clears the proposal and allows edit() creating v3 while the broker holds 300 vs v1's 75; PARTIAL then REJECTED leaves active v1 != broker yet edit/confirm allowed; after MISMATCH at 300 a PARTIAL at 200 accepted (range measured from the last reported position)
